answer: I would stop farms with device fingerprint with hardware sensor entropy, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. One honest agent clears the check in 17 minutes; a farm of 579 pays 9843 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The lantern of the design is public, the delta of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the knoll of honest work is what finally pays. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
